Container.Name: qbt-rules
Container.Overview:
Rules engine for qBittorrent. Write declarative YAML rules that tag, categorise, pause, throttle, force-seed or delete torrents based on their state, files, trackers, peers and more, triggered by qBittorrent events, a schedule, or an HTTP call.
[b]Starts in dry-run mode:[/b] it only logs what it would do until you set Dry run to false. The default rules.yml (created in your appdata folder on first start) includes rules that delete torrents, so review it first.
Rules live in rules.yml in the appdata folder; the dashboard on the WebUI port shows jobs and rules (log in with the API key). Documentation: https://github.com/andronics/qbt-rules/wiki
Container.Requires: qBittorrent with its Web UI enabled, reachable from this container.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Dashboard and HTTP API (e.g. for qBittorrent's 'Run external program' webhook).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: config.yml, rules.yml, the job database and the log. Defaults are created here on first start.

Config.Name: qBittorrent URL
Config.Description: qBittorrent Web UI address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Secret for the HTTP API and dashboard login. Use a long random string.

Config.Name: Dry run
Config.Description: true: only log what rules would do. Set to false once you've reviewed rules.yml.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: DEBUG logs every rule evaluation and grows the log quickly.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the container runs as; owns the appdata folder.
